desc:
CODES: (In Menu -> Store -> Codes)  MUST BE IN GROUP!!!
DEEPSEA

Heroes from the anime worlds fell through the Rift, and now they hide in the bushes of Odyssey. Become a Tamer and build your team!

- Pick your partner: a Ki, Fist or Blade hero, and watch it evolve.
- Catch wild Animon with Seal Cards. Every Animon is a parody of a famous anime fighter, redrawn in handheld-style pixel art.
- Win turn-based battles with flashy attacks, type matchups, items and status effects.
- Beat Tamers and Dojo Masters to earn Crests, from the Turtle Dojo to the Gizmo Dome.
- Explore Starfall Village, Nexus City and the Dragon Orb Frontier: climb Drain Tower, cross Thunderjaw Canyon and ride the Cloud.
- Take on Daily Bounties, collect your daily gift and duel your friends.

Early access: more regions, Dojos, trading and Legend Raids are on the way.

Animon Odyssey is a fan-made parody game and is not affiliated with any anime studio or publisher.
